jobs.title: Senior .NET Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

Ciklum
is looking for a Senior .NET Engineer
to join our team full-time in Bulgaria.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About The Role

As a Senior .NET Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Ciklum’s client is a global payments technology company providing payment processing, acquiring, and financial technology solutions to businesses worldwide.

Responsibilities

Lead the migration and redesign of legacy application functionality into scalable, cloud-ready microservices, maintaining total feature parity with existing business rules
Build high-performance RESTful Web APIs using C#, .NET Core, and the ASP.NET framework to support high-volume, transactional processing
Design relational data models, author complex T-SQL queries, and optimize performance across SQL Server and Azure SQL using Entity Framework
Manage source control, build automated deployment pipelines, and support cloud-ready solutions within Azure and Azure DevOps (ADO)
Analyze system requirements, troubleshoot high-volume transaction bottlenecks, and communicate complex architectural decisions with technical and business stakeholders

Requirements

Senior-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core (8+), ASP.NET, REST APIs, and microservices architecture
Proven track record modernizing legacy .NET Framework applications and web services into scalable, cloud-ready services
Hands-on experience building high-volume, high-reliability transactional systems (fintech or payment processing background preferred)
Expert-level knowledge of SQL Server and Azure SQL, including database design, T-SQL development, and performance tuning
Deep experience using Entity Framework for Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) and data access layers
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure DevOps (ADO) for version control, task tracking, and CI/CD pipeline management
Full mastery of Microsoft Visual Studio and standard .NET software engineering workflows
Exceptional analytical skills with strong written and verbal communication abilities
Upper-Intermediate level of English or higher

Desirable

Deep understanding of payment gateway architecture, transaction lifecycles, and payment domain security
Exposure to modern frontend stacks (React.js) or traditional server-rendered UIs (ASP.NET MVC / Razor) with JavaScript and jQuery

What’s in it for you?

Regular salary reviews based on performance
Corporate events: webinars, offline parties, and meetups
Internal Mobility Program
Tailored education path (including full access to Udemy, certifications, etc.)
25 paid days off: 20 business days of vacation per calendar year + 5 undocumented sick leave days
Additional health insurance
100% company-covered Multisport card, with discounts available for family members

About Us

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

Since expanding to Bulgaria in 2022, we’ve been building a fast-growing team that thrives on learning, collaboration, and innovation. Join us on this exciting journey and help shape the future of our delivery center.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Principal Software Engineer | .NET/C#, Azure, Angular | Global Commodities Data & Intelligence Platform

Salary: €61,500 + 10% bonus + company benefits
Location: Bulgaria, remote with just 2 days in the office per month
12 month fixed term contract

You will own .NET/C# engineering at the senior end of a Scrum team building the flagship platform behind a global commodities data and intelligence business. It serves customers across metals, forest products and agricultural markets with critical price data, news and analytics, delivered through web, desktop, API, Excel and mobile. The engineering team is global, spanning engineers, business analysts and product managers, and it is growing as the business scales its product delivery. The role is based in Bulgaria, remote bar a couple of office days a month.

As a Principal Engineer you report to the Engineering Manager and sit as an individual contributor, so you lead through technical direction rather than line management. Day to day you will write clean, performant code to SOLID principles, build high-scale distributed systems that stay fault-tolerant, and mentor the engineers around you on good design and engineering practice. The team takes an engineering approach to new services, favouring metrics over opinion.

What They're Looking For:

.NET/C#
Microsoft Azure (Service Fabric, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Blob Storage)
Distributed and cloud computing at scale, fault-tolerant systems
Solid design principles
Mentoring junior engineers and setting technical direction
Strong written and spoken English

What You'll Work With:

Angular, TypeScript
SQL Server and CosmosDB (NoSQL)
REST, WebSockets (SignalR) and gRPC
Redis (messaging and caching)
Microservices
Continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD), test automation and unit testing

Nice to Haves:

AI tooling to speed up development

Why Join?

You will be a principal engineer and an individual contributor, so this is technical leadership without line management. You set coding standards, guide design and mentor the engineers around you, while still writing production code yourself. The platform is the company's flagship product, delivering price data, news and analytics to global customers through web, desktop, API, Excel and mobile, so the systems you build carry serious load. The stack is modern .NET on Azure and the team reaches for the latest relevant technology in its work. The office ask is light, two days a month with the rest remote, and base salary comes with a 10% bonus.

If that mix of hands-on build and technical leadership fits where you are now, apply and I'll come back to you with the detail.

Principal Software Engineer | .NET/C#, Azure, Angular | Global Commodities Data & Intelligence Platform

Position Overview

LEGIC Identsystems Ltd. is a Swiss technology company headquartered in Wetzikon, Switzerland, with a strong global presence. For over 30 years, LEGIC has been a trusted pioneer in contactless smart cards, RFID technology and mobile credentials, delivering secure identification and access solutions to customers worldwide.

LEGIC Develops And Provides End-to-end Security Platforms That Enable Secure, Contactless Communication Between Transponders, Reader Systems, Mobile Devices And Our Cloud Service. Their Solutions Are Used In a Wide Range Of Applications, Including

Access control
Building security
Ticketing systems
Industrial IoT applications

With a focus on innovation, quality, and security, LEGIC serves a broad international customer base, partnering with system integrators and solution providers across multiple industries.

As a mid-sized, innovation-driven company, LEGIC offers a collaborative work environment where employees can make a real impact and contribute to cutting-edge technology that is shaping the future of secure digital identification.

What You Will Do

Specification, design and development of software for LEGIC Connect.
Strengthening the design and development expertise of the development team
Design and documentation of concepts, APIs, design and architecture
Integration of external interfaces/tools
Create automated tests to test the code completely automatically
Support through 2nd and 3rd level support for LEGIC Connect

Programming Language

Technical Stack:

Latest native Java version
vert.x
no spring boot

Cloud Infrastructure And Services

Orchestration: kubernetes
Storage: PostgreSQL
Message Bus: RabbitMQ

What we require

5+ years of backend software development
Degree from a university of Applied Sciences or higher education in IT/ Software Development, or equivalent practical experience in Software Development with Java

What we offer

Best opportunities in a globally operating company valuing diversity, inclusion, sustainability and mutual trust
Attractive remuneration package
Opportunity for flexibility with a hybrid working model
Home office allowance
25 days paid annual leave
Additional health insurance
200 BGN Food vouchers
Public transportation card
Optional parking space
Multisport card
Language training opportunity
Employee referral program
Brand new modern office premises in a class A Business building
Fresh fruits in the office
Training and mentorship programs
Access to over 15,000 LinkedIn Learning courses to assist in your development

Who we are

We are at the heart of every place that matters. From automatic doors to cloud-based access management – as a leading global provider in the access solutions market for schools, banks, airports, hospitals, hotels, and many more, we enable seamless movement within secure, safe, and sustainable places. With over 160 years of experience and a focus on excellence and innovation, we offer exciting opportunities to grow in an environment where you can make a real impact. At dormakaba, you are encouraged to take initiative, develop your skills, and build your career alongside 16,000 experts worldwide who are setting industry standards every day.

Work in a place where you matter – apply now!
